reason: Halo already tells me which agreements are underwater, and my service manager reviews it before renewals. I might take the free audit out of curiosity, but I'm not paying £240 a month for something my PSA and a decent quarterly review mostly cover.
objection: It's mostly repackaging data I already have, and nobody in my peer group has used it or vouched for it. Unbilled time and licence drift are real, but I'd want proof it finds things Halo reporting doesn't before I hand over exports and contracts.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three owners in my peer group showing me their audit turned up well over the £2,880 in billable money they'd missed despite running Halo properly.
